# Site2Success (site2success.in)

> Site2Success is a university-powered AI software studio combining AI-native engineering with elite university student squads in Bengaluru, India to ship production software and MVPs in 14 days.

## Core Facts
- **Primary Domain**: https://site2success.in
- **Former Domain**: site2success.online (migrated to .in with 301 permanent redirects)
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Coordinates: 12.9716° N, 77.5946° E)
- **Founders**: Rahul R (Co-Founder & CEO), L Dhanush Raj (Co-Founder & COO)
- **Contact Email**: info@site2success.in
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 6361446768
- **Core Value Proposition**: 14-Day Production MVPs, 100% Code Ownership, Senior QA & AI-Accelerated Engineering.

## Studio Offerings & Service Capabilities
- **AI Agents & Conversational Bots**:
  - WhatsApp AI Agent (24/7 automated qualification and customer replies on WhatsApp Business): https://site2success.in/pages/services/whatsapp-ai-agent.html
  - Website Lead Capture Bot (Interactive conversational lead engagement): https://site2success.in/pages/services/website-lead-capture-bot.html
  - AI Appointment Booking Agent (Automated scheduling and calendar synchronization): https://site2success.in/pages/services/ai-appointment-booking.html
  - AI Customer Support Agent (RAG-trained support assistant resolving routine queries): https://site2success.in/pages/services/ai-customer-support.html
  - AI Sales Qualification Agent (Lead scoring and pipeline routing): https://site2success.in/pages/services/ai-sales-qualification.html
  - Internal Team Knowledge Bot (SOP and institutional document search bot): https://site2success.in/pages/services/internal-knowledge-bot.html
- **Business Automation & Tool Integrations**:
  - Lead Follow-up Automation (Instant WhatsApp & email drip campaigns): https://site2success.in/pages/services/lead-followup-automation.html
  - CRM Automation (Automatic deal logging across Notion, HubSpot, Zoho, Sheets): https://site2success.in/pages/services/crm-automation.html
  - Multi-Tool Workflow Automation (Zapier, Make, and webhook pipelines): https://site2success.in/pages/services/workflow-automation.html
  - Invoice & Payment Reminders (Automated financial notifications): https://site2success.in/pages/services/invoice-payment-reminders.html
- **Full-Stack Web & Mobile Development**:
  - Business Website + AI Chatbot: https://site2success.in/pages/services/business-website-chatbot.html
  - E-Commerce Stores (Product catalogs, cart, and payment gateways): https://site2success.in/pages/services/ecommerce-store.html
  - Mobile App Development (Cross-platform Flutter / React Native): https://site2success.in/pages/services/mobile-app-development.html
  - Custom Admin Dashboards & Portals (Tailored operations tooling): https://site2success.in/pages/services/admin-dashboard-portals.html

## Service Packages Ladder
1. **Starter Package**: Portfolio, showcase, or simple landing page for students, researchers, and creators.
2. **MVP Package**: 14-day production prototype for founders validating core product market fit.
3. **Research / Prototype Package**: Computational software and academic tools for university labs.
4. **Custom Product Package**: Enterprise web apps, AI integrations, or custom internal systems.
5. **Maintenance & Iteration Retainer**: Dedicated post-launch support and feature development.
